reconstructed_captions.4: A hand uses a rotary cutter to cut along the chalk line, guided by the metal ruler.
reconstructed_captions.5: The rotary cutter slices cleanly through the black fabric on the cutting mat.
reconstructed_captions.6: The first piece of fabric is cut and the ruler is moved away.
reconstructed_captions.7: The process is repeated, with the hand cutting another piece of fabric.
reconstructed_captions.8: A close-up shows the sharp blade of the rotary cutter precisely following the chalk line.
reconstructed_captions.9: The second piece of fabric is now fully cut.
reconstructed_captions.10: The two cut pieces of black fabric are laid out on the work surface.
reconstructed_captions.11: A hand picks up one piece of fabric and places it directly on top of the other.
reconstructed_captions.12: The edges of the two fabric layers are carefully aligned with each other.
reconstructed_captions.13: A hand smooths the stacked fabric to remove any wrinkles or air pockets.
reconstructed_captions.14: A hand picks up a small sewing clip.
reconstructed_captions.15: The clip is attached to the edge of the fabric layers to hold them together.
reconstructed_captions.16: Several more clips are placed along the edge to secure the fabric for sewing.
reconstructed_captions.17: The clipped fabric piece is moved towards a sewing machine.
reconstructed_captions.18: The fabric is positioned under the needle of the sewing machine.
reconstructed_captions.19: A hand lowers the presser foot onto the fabric, holding it in place.
reconstructed_captions.20: The hand wheel is turned to lower the needle into the starting point of the seam.
reconstructed_captions.21: Hands are positioned to guide the fabric as the machine begins to sew.
